text: Read-only acquisition feasibility check while P02 timed fits run: do not count IBSR18 as fresh qualification. docs/benchmarks/real-world-registration.md documents all nine IBSR18 pairs as development-open external HodgeFlow evidence; docs/benchmarks/external-hodgeflow-visual-qa.md contains observed scores/plates. Inventory this exposure alongside OASIS/NKI-RS/MMRR before freezing any cohort. Candidate sources for further provenance/access review are LPBA40 (official LONI resources/atlases and atlases-downloads pages), Hammers individual adult atlases 30 (brain-development.org/brain-atlases/adult-brain-atlases/individual-adult-brain-atlases-30/), and Mindboggle NKI-TRT-20 (mindboggle.info/data.html links primary OSF data). Hammers requests personal/institutional details and has research-use conditions; LONI has an agreement flow. No registration, agreement, data download or fresh model-outcome inspection was performed. NKI-TRT identities must be checked against observed NKI-RS before considering them independent. If all three are eligible and subject-disjoint, 40+30+20 subjects can support 101 pairs in 31 disjoint blocks (10 quads; four quads plus seven dyads; ten dyads), satisfying P01 size rules without weakening them. This is a feasibility sketch, not a reserved or sealed manifest; annotation/landmark provenance, preprocessing independence, acquisition rights and replacement confirmation remain unresolved.
